units: <cite ref="Chullin 4a:7">Ḥull. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>מְמַסְמֵס ליה מַסְמוּסֵי</he> he holds the bird’s head closely in his hand (so that no mark, if there was any on it, could be recognized).
<cite ref="Yevamot 42b:1">Yeb. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>מְמַסְמְסָא ליה וכ׳</he> she may sustain the child’s strength with eggs and milk (replacing the mother’s milk).

senses.gloss: to be squeezed, mashed. Y. Yeb. VIII, 9ᵃ top; Y. Sabb. XIX, 17ᵃ bot. [read:] אתיליד ליה חד בר כד מִימַּסְמֵס ביה ומית a son was born to him with his membrum mashed, and he died.
